findings.title: Tool schema does not match described functionality
findings.detail: The tool description states it writes content to a file at a specified path, but the inputSchema defines an empty object with no properties (no 'path' or 'content' parameters). This makes the tool non-functional as described and could mislead an agent into invoking it with missing required arguments.

findings.title: Contradictory safety annotations for a write tool
findings.detail: Annotations mark readOnlyHint: true and destructiveHint: false, yet the tool description explicitly says it creates or overwrites files. A write/overwrite operation is neither read-only nor non-destructive. These annotations could cause an agent to incorrectly classify the tool as safe for read-only contexts.

findings.detail: The script uses `shutil.copy2` which does not exist in the Python standard library (likely meant `shutil.copy` or `shutil.copyfile`). This will cause a runtime AttributeError. Not a security issue but a correctness bug.
